create.blankHint: Start with an empty area and draw rooms, paths and labels.
create.description: Name the map and choose how to start: draw it yourself, use one of your templates or a picture.
create.name: Name
create.pictureHint: Upload a floor plan or a photo of a site map. You can still draw on top of it.
create.pictureSandbox: Not in the demo. In your own event you can upload a picture here.
create.templateHint: Copy the drawing of a map you saved as a template. You place the pins afterwards.
create.title: New map

decor.note: Decoration only helps people find their way. It isn't a place and has no shifts.
decor.title: Decoration

draw.conflict: Someone else changed this map in the meantime. We loaded the latest version.
draw.emptyHint: Draw your venue: drag to draw a room, or pick another tool above.
draw.labelHint: Tap where the text should go.
draw.pathHint: Tap to add points. Double-tap or press Finish to end the line.
draw.polygonHint: Tap to add corners. Tap the first corner or press Close shape to finish.
draw.propHint: Tap the map to add: {name}. Press Esc when you're done.
draw.stretchHint: Your drawing stretches to the picture's proportions. Check that everything still sits right.

inspector.label: Label
inspector.linkHint: Tapping this area opens the place.
inspector.moveLabelHint: Drag the small text handle on the map to move the label.

prop.keysHint: Keys: Q and E turn it, + and − change the size.
prop.title: Decoration

inspector.title: Selected drawing

marker.deleteConfirm: Remove the pin “{name}” from this map?
marker.label: Label
marker.locationHint: Its name and details are edited in the “Locations” tab.
marker.nudgeHint: Drag the pin to move it, or use the arrow keys (hold Shift for bigger steps).
marker.title: Selected pin

palette.allPlaced: All locations are on this map.
palette.hint: Pick something, then tap the map where it is.
palette.noLocations: No locations yet. Add them in the Locations tab.
palette.title: Add pins

picture.removeConfirm: Remove the picture from “{name}”? Your drawing and pins stay.
picture.title: Picture

plans.deleteConfirm: Delete the map “{name}” with all its pins? The locations themselves stay.
plans.emptyHint: Start with one map, for example of the whole grounds. You can add more later, like one per floor of a building.
plans.loadError: The maps could not be loaded.
plans.name: Name
plans.namePlaceholder: e.g. Grounds or Hall, ground floor
plans.renameDescription: The new name shows on the map's tab for everyone in the event.

settings.description: Upload a plan of your venue and pin where everything is. Helpers find it under “Map” and when they open a shift.
settings.title: Venue map

templates.createdFrom: Map added from the template. Now place your pins.
templates.deleteConfirm: Delete the template “{name}”? Maps you already made from it stay as they are.
templates.emptyHint: Open a map you have drawn and choose “Save as template” in its menu (⋮). You can then start new maps from it in all your events.
templates.loadError: Your templates could not be loaded.
templates.name: Name
templates.renameDescription: Only you can see your templates.
templates.saveDescription: Saves the drawing and the picture of this map, without pins. You can then start new maps from it in all your events. Changing this map later does not change the template.
templates.saved: Saved as template. You’ll find it under “+ Add map”.

tools.label: Text
tools.shortcutsHint: Shortcuts: V select, R rectangle, P shape, L line, T text, D decoration, G snapping. With a decoration selected: Q/E turn, +/− size. Ctrl+Z undoes drawing steps (not pins).
tools.title: Drawing tools

upload.hint: PNG, JPG or WebP. PDFs: export as image first.
upload.replaceHint: The pins stay where they are.
upload.sandboxHint: In your own event you upload a plan of your venue here. In the demo you can place, move and remove pins on the plans that are already there.
upload.sandboxReplace: Pictures cannot be replaced in the demo. In your own event you can upload a plan of your venue here.
upload.sandboxTitle: No picture uploads in the demo
upload.title: Add a picture of the venue
